title: A Net Mold-based Method of Scaffold-free Three-Dimensional Cardiac Tissue Creation
protocol: Coat 6-well plates with basement membrane matrix.
Culture human-induced pluripotent stem cells (hiPSCs).
Differentiate hiPSCs into hiPSC-CMs using previously described methods.
Rinse each well with 2 mL of 1x phosphate-buffered saline (PBS) without calcium or magnesium.
Incubate with 1 mL/well of trypsin or cell dissociation reagent for 5 min at room temperature.
Neutralize the trypsin or cell dissociation reagent using an equal volume of RPMI/B-27 cell media.
Pipette up and down to loosen any adhered cells.
Collect the suspended cardiomyocytes with a 10-mL serological pipette.
Transfer the collected suspension to a 50-mL conical tube.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 250 x g for 5 min at room temperature.
Resuspend the pellet in 10 mL of RPMI/B-27 cell media.
Combine 20 µL of cell suspension with an equal amount of 0.4% Trypan blue solution.
Mix gently to combine the solutions.
Use a manual hemocytometer to count and obtain the concentration and cell viability of the cell suspension.
Incubate HCFs with an appropriate amount of trypsin or cell dissociation reagent for 5 min at room temperature.
Neutralize the trypsin or cell dissociation reagent using an equal volume of medium.
Transfer the sample to a 50-mL conical tube.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 250 x g for 5 min at room temperature.
Resuspend the pellet in 10 mL of fibroblast growth medium.
Combine 20 µL of the HCF cell suspension with an equal amount of 0.4% trypan blue solution.
Mix gently and count cells using an automated cell counter or manual hemocytometer.
Incubate HUVECs with an appropriate amount of trypsin or cell dissociation reagent for 3 min at room temperature.
Neutralize the trypsin or cell dissociation reagent using an equal volume of medium.
Transfer to a 50-mL conical tube.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 250 x g for 5 min at room temperature.
Resuspend the pellet in 10 mL of endothelial cell growth medium.
Mix 20 µL of HUVEC suspension with an equal amount of 0.4% Trypan blue solution.
Count and obtain the concentration and viability of the cell suspension using a cell counter or hemocytometer.
Place the hanging drop device containing 850 micropores into sterile 6-well plates.
Combine hiPSC-CMs, HCFs, and HUVECs in a ratio of 70% iPSC-CMs, 15% HCFs, and 15% HUVECs in RPMI/B-27 cell media at a concentration of 2,475,000 cells per mL.
Dispense 4 mL of the combined cell suspension into each well of an ultra-low attachment hanging drop system.
Culture for 72 hours (3 days) at 37 °C, 5% CO2, and 95% humidity to mature the spheroids.
Harvest the spheroids by placing the device into a dish with medium and swirling it gently.
Assemble the base, bottom square plate, and bottom net using sterile forceps.
Stack and align the components on the corner posts.
Layer the 10 side nets in alternating directions to form a fine stainless-steel prong net.
Flush the filling base with PBS or medium to reduce surface tension.
Wet the assembled mold cavity with PBS or medium.
Fill the spheroids into the presupposed cavity, using 120% of the anticipated volume.
Assemble the top net and top square plate onto the corner posts.
Secure stoppers and holding tubes to prevent washout of the spheroids.
Transfer the filled mold system to a 6-well plate with 6 mL of RPMI/B-27 cell media or into a sterile container with sufficient medium.
Incubate the 6-well plate on a swinging shaker for 7 - 10 days at 3,000 - 4,000 x g.
Remove the mold system from the media.
Place the mold system on the sterilized handling mat in a sterile 10-cm dish.
Remove the holding tube and stoppers.
Remove the top square plate and the top net.
Carefully slide out the layered side nets one by one with sterile forceps.
Obtain an intact cardiac patch atop the bottom net after decannulation.
Pick up the bottom net with the patch using sterile forceps.
Transfer the bottom net into a 35-mm dish with 5 mL of RPMI/B27 media.
Gently loosen the patch from the bottom net by slowly swirling the net in the dish or using a sterile cell scraper.
After detachment, culture the cardiac tissue with RPMI/B27 media.
Incubate the free-floating 3-D cardiac patch in the 35-mm dish.
